{
  "name": "rjmlaird-tools",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@9.15.0",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "pnpm -r --parallel dev",
    "build": "pnpm -r build",
    "typecheck": "pnpm -r --if-present typecheck",
    "test": "pnpm -r --if-present test",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "format": "prettier --write .",
    "brand:sync": "node scripts/brand.mjs sync",
    "brand:check": "node scripts/brand.mjs check",
    "verify": "pnpm brand:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build"
  },
  "prettier": "@rjmlaird/prettier-config",
  "devDependencies": {
    "@rjmlaird/eslint-config": "workspace:*",
    "@rjmlaird/prettier-config": "workspace:*",
    "eslint": "^9.14.0",
    "prettier": "^3.3.3",
    "typescript": "^5.6.3",
    "wrangler": "^4.0.0"
  }
}
